title: Windward Stair - Stone & Gust
_note: Option B mood sibling. gbc 4-voice band. 6/8 compound meter (6 eighths per bar), bright A major with a grounded F#-minor lean (the Stone half). A careful step-step-rest climbing gait, more solitary than triumphant. Vesper motif RESET into compound meter: leap-and-settle becomes a step-step-leap-settle gait figure, the overshoot landing softly on a triplet/offbeat. Intermittent lonelier gust swells (ohat) less frequently than Option A. 18-bar loop; last bar steps down to E (dominant) -> voice-leads up into the bar-1 A lift.
